light_description: Early one-knob high-gain fuzz documented by the builder as the circuit basis for later 轟哭之歪 and the design lineage behind 不屈毛羽立.
Three-control fuzz with VOL/TONE/GAIN; the builder describes it as derived from DOSUKOI with an additional amplification stage and Muff-style tone network.
Volume-only high-gain fuzz developed as a self-mod and one-knob version of 轟哭之歪, with builder-adjusted internal controls and documented 2026 design story.
Two-knob fuzz with VOLUME, FUZZ and upper-octave switch; builder documentation describes bias-based fuzz control ranging from gated/broken sustain to distortion-like fuzz.
Mid-focused fuzz with parametric EQ controls and three gain-use modes; official shop page provides full product description and exterior/product imagery.
Current fuzz/overdrive with Fuzz Volume, Blend and Fuzz controls; official shop describes it as an evolution of the previous model and a way to add fuzz without losing the core dry signal.
Current CMOS fuzz with Volume and Fuzz controls; official shop documents its low-gain-to-drive behavior and responsive guitar-volume character.
Two-channel parametric equalizer with a fuzz channel; retained as relationship-only because its primary identity is EQ/preamp utility despite the integrated fuzz path.
